description: Add an audio overlay (mp3/m4a/wav/ogg) scheduled at a frame-aligned start. The asset must already be uploaded (upload_audio, create_upload_link, or the editor); pass the upload's returned `filename`, and its `name` as the track's label. 30 fps; convert seconds with frames = round(s * 30). Plays in the editor preview and is mixed into the MP4 export.

endFrame.description: Optional end frame; omit to play the asset's full natural length from startFrame.

fadeInFrames.description: Linear fade-in length in frames. Default 0.

fadeOutFrames.description: Linear fade-out length in frames. Default 0.

filename.description: The stored audio filename an upload returned.

name.description: Optional label people see on the track: pass the upload's returned `name`.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

sourceLayerId.description: Optional video layer element id ("video.<id>") to weld this overlay to. When set, the editor renders the overlay as a waveform footer on that clip and drags it with the clip instead of showing a standalone bottom row.

startFrame.description: Frame at which the overlay starts (0-indexed, 30 fps).

name: add_audio_overlay

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
